definitions.explanation: Extra space, time, or capacity beyond what is strictly needed.
A relaxed, unhurried state of mind. The psychological sense of having enough breathing room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゆとり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゆとり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no room in the budget.

examples.japanese: ゆとり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んだ→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to build some margin into the schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ゆとり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧ゆとり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I'm so busy that I have no composure.

examples.japanese: ゆとり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live a relaxed life.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ゆとり (time to spare)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ゆとり (peace of mind)
- ⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧なゆとり (financial margin)
- ゆとり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have margin/composure)
- ゆとり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no room/composure)

CULTURAL NOTE:
ゆとり⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (relaxed education) was Japan's educational reform policy from roughly 2002-2012 that reduced curriculum content and school hours. The term ゆとり{世代|せだい} (the "relaxed generation") refers to people educated under this system, sometimes used pejoratively.
